content.short: Cedar Money moves cross-border B2B payments using stablecoins, with a focus on emerging and African markets.
content.description: Cedar Money is a cross-border payments company that uses stablecoins to move money between developed and emerging markets, with a strong focus on Africa. It lets businesses send and collect payments across more than 190 countries, manage foreign exchange and hold funds through a familiar interface, while stablecoins handle settlement in the background so customers never hold digital assets themselves. Cedar reports processing more than a billion dollars a year for exporters, importers and fintechs in corridors covering Nigeria, Kenya, South Africa, Ghana and Togo. It raised 9.9 million dollars in a round led by QED Investors.
